slots.notes: Fullscreen looping hero background video for SecuritySection (absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover, autoPlay loop muted playsInline). It fills a min-h-[600px] h-screen container and sits under a top black-to-transparent fade overlay plus white overlaid pill nav and two white/80-90 paragraphs, so supply a dark, low-contrast cinematic loop that keeps white text and the orange gradient pill legible. Crop-tolerant (object-cover, no reserved text safe-area).

Four monochrome white-fill logo glyphs (h-6 w-6 sm:h-8 sm:w-8, fill white, viewBox 0 0 24 24), one centered in each CompaniesSection card next to a text wordmark: Apex (star), forge (hex/cube), Eastern Delta (W), Skybank (stacked diamonds). Currently authored as inline <svg> path elements baked directly into the card markup, not external files — a reskin swaps the four paths/wordmarks wholesale. Single-color marks that must read as white over a near-black neutral-950 card with soft blurred color blobs behind them.

The single typeface for the entire page (nav, headlines, body, wordmarks), loaded via an onlinewebfonts.com @import as 'Futura Md BT Medium' with a system-ui / -apple-system / sans-serif fallback stack. Geometric medium-weight sans set in all-lowercase with antialiasing; the substitute should hold a clean geometric lowercase look at small body sizes (13-18px) and the larger 3xl card wordmarks.

mechanic: Two stacked black sections — a full-height hero with a looping background video under a top fade, a centered glass pill nav and two floating paragraphs, above a 2/4-col grid of neutral-950 logo cards lit by blurred color blobs — with no JS animation; all motion comes from the looping video.
techDelivery: React + TypeScript components styled with Tailwind CSS utility classes (no extra libraries beyond React and Tailwind), mobile-first responsive across default/sm/md tiers, with a single onlinewebfonts @import for the Futura web font and a few inline style props for linear-gradient fills.
